# Splitter

Header: `winui/ui/panes/Splitter.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/panes/Splitter.hpp`.

A draggable divider that resizes along one axis, between two [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) tracks or two panes.

Place it in a [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) track of its own with a track on either side: a column for a Vertical bar, a row for a Horizontal one. It then resizes those two tracks within their min and max ([GridControl::resize_beside()](grid.md#resize_beside)). With an [on_drag_delta()](#on_drag_delta) handler it resizes nothing and passes each delta to the handler, for a layout of the caller's own. While it has focus, the arrow keys along its axis resize too. It fills the available length along its axis and is [thickness()](#thickness) across it. The declarative form is [ui::Splitter](#uisplitter).

Example: 
```cpp
using ui::operator""_fr;
using ui::operator""_dip;

window.set_content(ui::Grid{
    .columns   = {ui::minmax(80_dip, 1_fr), 6_dip, 1_fr},
    .min_width = 420.0f,
    .content   = {
        ui::Cell{.column = 0, .content = ui::Button{.text = "Left"}},
        ui::Cell{.column = 1, .content = ui::Splitter{}}, // drag or arrow keys move the two columns
        ui::Cell{.column = 2, .content = ui::Button{.text = "Right"}},
    },
});

// A layout of your own: the handler gets the deltas and the splitter resizes nothing.
ui::Property<float> top_height{200.0f};
auto splitter = std::make_unique<ui::SplitterControl>(ui::Orientation::Horizontal);
splitter->on_drag_delta([&](float dy) { top_height = std::max(40.0f, top_height.get() + dy); });
```

## `ui::Splitter`

A draggable divider. Builds a [ui::SplitterControl](#uisplittercontrol).

In a [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) track of its own between two others it resizes those two tracks, by drag or by the arrow keys, within their [`ui::minmax()`](grid.md#minmax) limits. For a layout of your own, set [`.on_drag_delta`](#uisplitter-on_drag_delta). The splitter then resizes nothing and passes on each delta in DIPs. Add the delta to [GridControl::column_size()](grid.md#column_size), not to a neighbor's bounds(). Bounds are already shrunk by margins, so feeding them back collapses the track on the first drag.

Example: 
```cpp
using ui::operator""_dip;
using ui::operator""_fr;

window.set_content(ui::Grid{
    .columns = {ui::minmax(120_dip, 200_dip), ui::AutoSize, 1_fr},
    .content = {
        ui::Cell{.column = 0, .content = ui::Text{.text = "Folders"}},
        ui::Cell{.column = 1, .content = ui::Splitter{}},
        ui::Cell{.column = 2, .content = ui::Text{.text = "Messages"}},
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Splitter{
    .orientation, .thickness, .focusable, .keyboard_increment, .style, .margin, .width,
    .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_drag_delta,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uisplitter-orientation"></span>`orientation` | `ui::Orientation` | `ui::Orientation::Vertical` | The bar's own axis. Vertical (the default) is a vertical bar dragged left and right to resize columns. Horizontal resizes rows. |
| <span id="uisplitter-thickness"></span>`thickness` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{6.0f}` | The bar's thickness across its axis, DIPs. |
| <span id="uisplitter-focusable"></span>`focusable` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the bar takes focus. With focus, the arrow keys along the drag axis resize as a drag does, four times as far with Shift. On by default. |
| <span id="uisplitter-keyboard_increment"></span>`keyboard_increment` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{8.0f}` | One arrow-key step, DIPs; four times as far with Shift. |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_drag_delta"></span>`on_drag_delta` | `ui::Callback<void(float)>` |  | The drag or key step along the drag axis since the previous call, DIPs. Positive is right or down. Setting it turns off the resizing of the [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) tracks beside the bar. |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uisplitter-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uisplitter-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Splitter>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |

Place it in a [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) track of its own with a track on either side: a column for a Vertical bar, a row for a Horizontal one. ### SplitterControl

```cpp
SplitterControl(Orientation orientation = Orientation::Vertical)
```

A 6 DIP bar along [`orientation`](#orientation), focusable.

### orientation

```cpp
Orientation orientation() const
```

The bar's axis, fixed at construction.

### thickness

```cpp
float thickness() const
```

The bar's size across its axis, in DIPs; 6 by default.

### set_thickness

```cpp
void set_thickness(float thickness)
```

Changes the thickness and lays the bar out again.

### on_drag_delta

```cpp
void on_drag_delta(Callback<void(float)> handler)
```

Fired while the pointer drags or an arrow key steps, with the movement in DIPs since the previous call. The axis follows [`orientation`](#orientation): x for Vertical, y for Horizontal. Setting a handler turns off the resizing of the [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) tracks beside the bar.

### dragging

```cpp
bool dragging() const
```

Whether a pointer drag is in progress: the button went down on the bar and is still held.

### hovered

```cpp
bool hovered() const
```

Whether the pointer is over the bar. The bar draws the accent separator while hovered or dragged.

### set_focusable

```cpp
void set_focusable(bool focusable)
```

Whether the bar takes focus; true by default. With focus, ArrowLeft/Right (Vertical) or ArrowUp/Down (Horizontal) resize by +/- [keyboard_increment()](#keyboard_increment), or four times that with Shift held. False leaves it out of the tab order.

### focusable

```cpp
bool focusable() const override
```

Whether the bar is a tab stop: [set_focusable()](#set_focusable), and only while enabled.

### focused

```cpp
bool focused() const
```

Whether the bar has keyboard focus.

### keyboard_increment

```cpp
float keyboard_increment() const
```

The arrow-key step, in DIPs; 8 by default. Set a different step, such as one grid unit, with [set_keyboard_increment()](#set_keyboard_increment).

### set_keyboard_increment

```cpp
void set_keyboard_increment(float increment)
```

Sets the arrow-key step, in DIPs.

### cursor_at

```cpp
std::optional<CursorShape> cursor_at(Point) const override
```

The resize arrow along the drag axis: west-east for a vertical bar, north-south for a horizontal one.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Reported to screen readers as a Thumb with no value, because the splitter reports relative movement and has no bounded value of its own.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

[thickness()](#thickness) across the axis by the available length along it ([thickness()](#thickness) when unbounded).

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

A 1 pixel divider at rest, and a 2 pixel accent separator while hovered or dragged.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

Starts a drag on a press over the bar, reports each move's delta and ends on release.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool) override
```

Called by the [Window](../tree/window.md) as focus arrives or leaves; redraws.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

The arrow keys along the axis step by [keyboard_increment()](#keyboard_increment), four times as far with Shift.
